PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Manufofin Sirri
PrivacyPolicyPage.acceptSubtitle: Da fatan za a karanta kuma a yarda da manufar sirri ta cibiyar ku kafin ci gaba.
PrivacyPolicyPage.acceptRequired: Da fatan za a yarda da manufar sirri don ci gaba.
PrivacyPolicyPage.emptyPolicy: Cibiyar ku ba ta buga manufar sirri ba tukuna. Kuna iya ci gaba bayan kun yarda.
